leg.text: Dakkon Blackblade is a master blacksmith whom Geyadrone Dihada offers to make a planeswalker if he forges the Blackblade, which he does over ten years, killing a slave with it each time.
Dihada ignites his spark but stabs the sword into his shadow, binding his soul into the blade, and later she tricks a boy into summoning and binding Dakkon, robbing him of planeswalking.
Dakkon bests Sol'Kanar, banishes Chromium and kills Piru with the Blackblade, and the blast creates the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.
Dihada reveals that the monk was herself, absorbs Piru's soul, and her glyph binds Dakkon to her for eternity, so that he and the boy travel to Terisiare, where the boy starts the Carthalion legacy.

mh2.text: In Modern Horizons 2, Dakkon was a master smith of unrivaled artistry before he was subjugated by demonic forces.
As he forged the Blackblade for Geyadrone Dihada, he unwittingly forged himself into her schemes.
